sloka: तस्मिन् वालिनि दुर्वृत्ते निपतिष्यन्ति वेगिताः ।कन्क पत्र प्रतिच्छन्ना महेन्द्र अशनि संनिभाः ॥४-५-२७॥
transliteration: tasmin vālini durvṛtte nipatiṣyanti vegitāḥ ।kanka patra praticchannā mahendra aśani saṁnibhāḥ ॥4-5-27॥

translations.english: 'These arrows covered with kanka feathers, sharp and straight at the tip, comparable to great Indra's thunderbolt are (burning bright) like the sun. Looking like angry serpents, they will unfailingly strike at the miscreant Vali soon.
